### Main color

::: {.d-flex .align-items-center .gap-3 .my-3}
[]{style="display:inline-block;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:8px;background:#234a18;"}

**LEDT green** · HEX `#234A18` · RGB 35, 74, 24
:::

### Good practice

-   Do not distort, crop, rotate or recolor the logo.
-   Keep clear space around the logo and use it on light backgrounds.
-   When LEDT appears with other institutions, keep the logos at visually equivalent sizes.

## Institutional logos

Logos of LEDT's home and partner institutions, for use in presentations and posters.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Each institution has its own brand guidelines. When in doubt, download the official version:

-   **UFAM:** [UFAM Visual Identity](https://www.ufam.edu.br/identidade-visual-ufam.html) · [Visual Identity Manual (Edoc)](https://edoc.ufam.edu.br/handle/123456789/1996)
-   **INPA:** contact INPA's Communication Office or visit the [INPA website](https://www.gov.br/inpa/pt-br)
:::
